name: Twin Hammers
design_intent:
TRIALS SURVIVE proof course #2 -- the HARDER rhythm (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.2, owner example 'two swinging hammers'; escalates past t_hammer_vigil). Parked on ONE WIDE trampoline pad under TWO lethal spinning_hammers (the proven hammer hazard) whose bottom-of-arc blades sweep the pad in a SYNCOPATED cross-rhythm (phase 0.0 / 0.5). Where t_hammer_vigil is one blade / one clear beat, this is two blades whose threat columns OVERLAP so there is no static safe tile -- you must read BOTH clocks and boost-hop into the rotating pocket the two sweeps leave. A death (a blade OR a void fall) RESETS that player's survival clock to 0 -- a weightless RETRY (v10: no penalty, no death score). Clean (0 deaths) = gold.

PILLAR-2 / S-CAMP: pivots at x640 and x1240 with arm_len 640 => each blade threatens pad-standers across x~(pivot +/- 290) at bottom-of-arc; blade radius 80 widens each threat column so the two UNION to cover the whole pad interior (x300-1580) with no permanent gap. Every x is swept by some blade each ~4.4s period, so there is NO static tile to idle the timer out on -- the safe pocket ROTATES with the offset phases, forcing a constant left<->right shuttle. (Comparable-or-tighter than the shipped t_hammer_vigil; exact camp-freeness wants a movement-bot confirm.)

MOVEMENT-TOOL / FLIGHT-REQUIRED (Rule A): the safe pocket moves ~450-600px each beat; air_drift_max 340px/s cannot re-cross the pad inside a blade's dwell window, so BOOST (760px/s) is required each beat to reach the next open pocket -- passive bouncing/drifting is swept. The dodge itself is the flight requirement (SURVIVE fantasy §2.2).

MOTION vs current Tuning (mirrors the validated t_hammer_vigil): pivot y340 + arm_len 640 => blade bottom-of-arc y~980 (40px over pad top 1020) so a center-standing player is struck as a blade crosses; arc_deg 140 (+/-70deg) sweeps each blade's apexes well off its own threat column; period 4.4s (a touch faster than vigil's 5.0), dwell_frac 0.30 => two clear dwells + two sweeps per revolution, offset 0.5 between the pair. The SPAWN (640,400) sits just below hammer-1's pivot in thin-arm/clear air (the vigil spawn pattern), out of both blades' reach at all phases -> a phase-safe drop onto the pad. NO Tuning constant is touched -- the blades kill via the existing kill(&"ring_out") pipeline.

SURVIVE (provisional 14s; v10: binary, no medal). [HISTORICAL - v10 removed medals/par; binary completion] medal_survive (max deaths): gold 0 (clean), silver 1, bronze 5. FLAG: strict S-CAMP camp-freeness wants a confirm pass; medal thresholds OBSOLETE (v10 binary completion).
